newLayers.name: Java and Python API Bridges
newLayers.description: The language facing APIs of core: JavaSparkContext, JavaRDD, JavaPairRDD and JavaDoubleRDD wrap the Scala API for Java callers, with Optional, StorageLevels and the Java status tracker, while api/python holds the JVM side of PySpark: the Py4J gateway server, Python partitioner and Hadoop data conversion helpers.

tour.title: The Java API and the Py4J gateway
tour.description: JavaSparkContext and the JavaRDD classes are thin wrappers that give Java callers the same operations as the Scala SparkContext and RDD, converting functions and collections. On the Python side, PythonGatewayServer starts a Py4JServer that the PySpark driver connects to, so Python can call JVM objects, and helpers such as PythonPartitioner and PythonHadoopUtil convert partitioners and Hadoop data between the two sides.
